main_text.head: DE AGRO FRISIÆ INTER AMASUM ET LAVICAM FLUMINA.
main_text.p: URbs Groninga proximis aliquot sæculis amplissima, splendidissima, & validissima in Frisiis fuit: eademque situ penè medio regionis ab occidente in orientem porrectæ, ideoq; omnibus ferè rebus ejus magnis bello ac pace implicita; denique Reip. formâ præ cæteris insignis, atque optimè habens. Quapropter operæ pretium visum, seorsim quædam de eâ differere, & explicare accuratius, eaque explicatione lucem affundere multis partibus Historiæ nostratis. Et primùm quidem de agro dicam Summa operis ordo.breviter, in quo urbs sita est, deque fluminibus agrum percurrentibus: tum de ipsa urbe, de jure Ultrajectino, de pactis & foederibus ejus, de conatu & armis

page.notes: The circular ink stamp on the right margin and the stamp marks in the margin are not transcribed. The note "Summa operis ordo." is partly overprinted by a stamp; its wording is read from the visible letters. Catchword "armis" is printed at the lower right with a bracket-like flourish. Signature "A" is printed at the lower left.
